sanskrit_verse:
धर्मासनगतः श्रीमान् दण्डं धत्ते यदा नृपः
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु तदा वैवस्वतः यमः
transliteration: dharmāsanagataḥ śrīmān daṇḍaṃ dhatte yadā nṛpaḥ | samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tadā vaivasvataḥ yamaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the ruler, seated upon the seat of Dharma, upholds the rod of justice without partiality towards any being, then he becomes Yama of Vaivasvata, the executor of cosmic law.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Dharma, not institutional position
Causation arises through conscious impartiality in execution
Capacity-based responsibility is activated when one occupies the seat of judgment
Restoration logic operates through equality of application, not punitive differentiation
Consciousness alignment determines the legitimacy of juridical action
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler occupies dharma-asana AND applies daṇḍa without bias THEN activation of vaivasvata-yama authority IS triggered
IF partiality is detected in judicial execution THEN legitimacy of ruling ENTITY is nullified UNTIL realignment occurs
IF consciousness-level of judge < threshold of sama-bhāva THEN automated suspension of adjudicative capacity SHALL occur
IF all beings are treated equally under law THEN restoration of dharmic order IS ensured
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that the Chief Justice or presiding authority becomes a legitimate representative of Vaivasvata Yama only when seated in pure neutrality. Any traceable bias invalidates the authority's alignment with Dharma, requiring immediate cessation and restoration protocol before further rulings proceed.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that impartiality is the causal factor for lawful action. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that inequality manifests disorder; thus proportional responsibility lies in maintaining samatā. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that true justice restores balance rather than inflicts suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Impartiality Assessment Protocol: Continuous monitoring of cognitive-emotive patterns during judicial execution
Dharma Seat Re-alignment Process: Meditative recalibration to re-establish sama-bhāva prior to resuming authority
Vaivasvata-Yama Activation Sequence: Only initiated upon verified absence of bias across all sentient categories
Consciousness Integrity Restoration: Mandatory retreat and purification until full neutrality is reinstated
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Justice flows solely from impartial consciousness aligned with Dharma. All authority derives its validity from this source. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
